title: thymus pulegioides subsp. pulchellus
intro: Thymus pulegioides subsp. pulchellus, commonly known as Thymus pulchellus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a small, herbaceous perennial with fragrant leaves and purple flowers, native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, which can aid in treating respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Thymus pulchellus include expectorant, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, with bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids contributing to its medicinal effects.
